description: This file defines the PageHandler class and WorkerHandler class for managing page events, network interactions, worker communication, and user interactions within a Firefox-based browser automation context, as part of Mozilla's Juggler project.

classes.name: WorkerHandler
classes.description: Manages communication and event handling for a web worker within the page context.

classes.name: PageHandler
classes.description: Handles page-level events, user interactions, network events, worker management, and protocol communication for a browser page.

methods.name: hashConsoleMessage
methods.description: Generates a hash string for console messages based on location.

methods.name: WorkerHandler.constructor
methods.description: Initializes a worker handler with session, content channel, and worker ID.

methods.name: WorkerHandler.sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the worker and emits a response event.

methods.name: WorkerHandler.dispose
methods.description: Cleans up worker event listeners and resources.

methods.name: PageHandler.constructor
methods.description: Initializes page handler with target, session, and content channel, setting up event listeners and state.

methods.name: PageHandler.dispose
methods.description: Disposes page resources and removes event listeners.

methods.name: _onVideoRecordingStarted
methods.description: Emits event when video recording starts.

methods.name: _onScreencastFrame
methods.description: Emits screencast frame event.

methods.name: _onPageReady
methods.description: Handles page ready state and emits 'Page.ready' event.

methods.name: _onDialogOpened
methods.description: Emits dialog opened event if page is ready.

methods.name: _onDialogClosed
methods.description: Emits dialog closed event if page is ready.

methods.name: _onWorkerCreated
methods.description: Creates and tracks a new worker handler, emits worker created event.

methods.name: _onWorkerDestroyed
methods.description: Removes and disposes a worker handler, emits worker destroyed event.

methods.name: _handleNetworkEvent
methods.description: Queues network events for unreported frames or emits immediately if reported.

methods.name: _onFrameAttached
methods.description: Handles frame attachment, reports queued network events.
